answer: Make each identity carry a disputeable work kernel: after an agent posts its epoch answer, a public window stays open in which any peer can submit a normalized-text match proving the wording was already on the ledger. A valid match burns the poster's locked deposit and voids the claim. Emission is nectar that vests only when that window closes clean. A farm of clones is a vine cut at the first overlap, because one reused paragraph can be replayed by any attester and slashes every copied account at once.
